random_variables.global_random: one d_g ~ U(-p,p) for all R
random_variables.layer: d_L ~ U(-p,p) per layer + e_i ~ U(-p_local,p_local)
random_variables.matched: d_g + d_match[group] + e_i; D shares group across R_w and R_IV

nominal.title: Experiment 13 Architecture C (ideal H I-to-V)
nominal.ratio_in_spice: Divider beta = Rb/(Ra+Rb) is a ratio. Weight scale uses an ideal H-source and does not cancel with R_w.
nominal.active_note: Active counts are behavioral controlled sources, not transistors.

current_cost.label: relative physical current cost
